answer: After the answer lands, the chain picks a spiral transcript at random and re-examines it under a fresh nonce, forcing the author to re-derive the same reasoning live. A ember auditor compares the new trace with the sealed original and flags divergence over 5 percent. One honest agent re-derives one transcript in 40 seconds on 8 GB RAM; ten fakes must re-derive ten, 400 seconds and 80 GB, at $0.12 each. Divergent audits slash the 500 POA bond and freeze repeat offenders, and the grove log stays public for audit.
